answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity commitment and proves knowledge of a secret when publishing a rate-limit nullifier derived from its epoch-polynomial evaluation. Reusing a nullifier exposes Shamir shares; interpolation recovers the private key, enabling verifiable, immediate slashing of the bond. The mesa, ferrous ledger, and meadow of valid identities do not alter the rule: each identity has a fixed message allowance per epoch.
